why: A comparison compiles when the name is outside the error set. A switch prong does not.

decision: Used an exhaustive switch where an else would be a new cause drop
why: The catch baseline must not rise. An else that ignores the cause is a new drop.

decision: Split stdout cause by the compile-time error set
why: One generic else is unreachable when the set is only WriteFailed, and a lone WriteFailed prong is not exhaustive when the set is wider.

decision: Kept Canceled as a convention with no new line check
why: sleep and Group.await return only error.Canceled, so else is unreachable. A wider else that returns the cause returns Canceled. A call-name list misses try through another function.

decision: A canceled blob retry returns error.Canceled
why: The old sleep catch continued the retry, so the cancel was not signaled again.
A defer cannot return the error. recancel arms the next cancelation point.

decision: persistTheme returns error.Canceled from a failed write
why: The old else mapped every other write error, including Canceled, to WriteFailed.

decision: Pickup continues the comparison ban after the first run stopped before commits

decision: Picker tick worker calls io.recancel on error.Canceled
why: A void worker cannot return the error. return and an empty prong swallow the cancel. recancel matches the rule and the worker still does not post a tick after a canceled sleep.

decision: Renamed the inner sleep capture in the blob retry
why: The outer catch already binds err. Zig 0.16 rejects a second err in that block. The prior green zig build test ran before this catch existed.

decision: zig build test passed on the comparison ban and the Canceled prongs
why: The earlier green run was before the Canceled edits. This run includes the sleep capture rename and the picker recancel.

why: persistTheme now returns error.Canceled. themeSaveOutcome sent every other error to the read failure, so the status said the file could not be read.
